title: Identity audit, retention and lawful evidence access
workflow: Capture onboarding and identity change with actor, purpose and source identifier
Write immutable metadata audit under controlled access separate from raw evidence storage
Determine lawful retention period from institution/jurisdiction policy
Provide purpose-scoped retrieval to qualified auditors or authorized customers
Apply redaction, pseudonymization or lawful deletion when retention conditions permit
Document export, access request and destruction decisions with audit proof
requirements: Legal statutory retention and customer deletion requests require case-by-case qualified resolution
Do not store unredacted IDs or document images in general application logs
Metadata audit cannot be edited by routine CIF users
Regulated customer records cannot be exported across institutions without legal authorization
Archived evidence must be encrypted, access logged and cryptographically verifiable where policy requires
Period expiry alone does not authorize deletion under active legal hold or litigation preservation
acceptance_cases: Authorized audit reconstructs every identity approval version
Ordinary user cannot read protected evidence bytes
Deletion while legal hold active denied with reason
Audit export stays within subject/institution scope
Tampered audit event fails integrity verification
approval_gate: Legal retention schedule, privacy/records authority, key custody rules and audit-retrieval tests.
